action.script:
set -u

if [[ -z "${NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR:-}" ]]; then
  print -u2 "无法确定输出目录，请一次拖入同一文件夹中的文档。"
  exit 2
fi

soffice_bin="$(command -v soffice 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -z "$soffice_bin" ]]; then
  for candidate in \
    "/Applications/LibreOffice.app/Contents/MacOS/soffice" \
    "$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin/override/soffice"
  do
    if [[ -x "$candidate" ]]; then
      soffice_bin="$candidate"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

pdftoppm_bin="$(command -v pdftoppm 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -z "$pdftoppm_bin" ]]; then
  for candidate in \
    "$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/native/poppler/poppler/bin/pdftoppm" \
    "$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin/override/pdftoppm"
  do
    if [[ -x "$candidate" ]]; then
      pdftoppm_bin="$candidate"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

pdfinfo_bin="$(command -v pdfinfo 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -z "$pdfinfo_bin" ]]; then
  for candidate in \
    "$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/native/poppler/poppler/bin/pdfinfo" \
    "$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin/override/pdfinfo"
  do
    if [[ -x "$candidate" ]]; then
      pdfinfo_bin="$candidate"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

python_bin=""
python_candidates=(
  "$(command -v python3 2>/dev/null || true)"
  "/opt/homebrew/bin/python3"
  "/usr/local/bin/python3"
  "/usr/bin/python3"
  "$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3"
)
for candidate in "${python_candidates[@]}"; do
  if [[ -n "$candidate" && -x "$candidate" ]]; then
    python_bin="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done

profile_dir="$NOTCH_TEMP_DIR/libreoffice-profile"
mkdir -p "$profile_dir"

if [[ -n "$soffice_bin" && "$soffice_bin" == *"/.cache/codex-runtimes/"* ]]; then
  font_cache_dir="$NOTCH_TEMP_DIR/font-cache"
  fontconfig_file="$NOTCH_TEMP_DIR/fonts.conf"
  mkdir -p "$font_cache_dir"
  cat > "$fontconfig_file" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig>
  <dir>/System/Library/Fonts</dir>
  <dir>/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental</dir>
  <dir>/Library/Fonts</dir>
  <dir>$HOME/Library/Fonts</dir>
  <dir>/System/Library/Assets/com_apple_MobileAsset_Font3</dir>
  <dir>/System/Library/Assets/com_apple_MobileAsset_Font4</dir>
  <cachedir>$font_cache_dir</cachedir>
  <alias>
    <family>sans-serif</family>
    <prefer>
      <family>Arial Unicode MS</family>
      <family>Hiragino Sans GB</family>
      <family>Heiti SC</family>
    </prefer>
  </alias>
</fontconfig>
EOF
  export FONTCONFIG_FILE="$fontconfig_file"
fi

outputs=()
details=""
index=0

for file in "${(@f)NOTCH_FILES}"; do
  [[ -n "$file" ]] || continue
  [[ -f "$file" ]] || {
    print -u2 "找不到文件：$file"
    exit 3
  }

  filename="${file:t}"
  base="${filename:r}"
  ext="${filename:e}"
  ext="${ext:l}"

  case "$ext" in
    pdf) target_ext="docx" ;;
    doc|docx) target_ext="pdf" ;;
    *)
      print -u2 "不支持的文件格式：$filename"
      exit 4
      ;;
  esac

  index=$((index + 1))
  job_dir="$NOTCH_TEMP_DIR/job-$index"
  mkdir -p "$job_dir"
  staged="$job_dir/$base.$target_ext"
  input_note=""

  if [[ "$ext" == "pdf" ]]; then
    if [[ -z "$pdftoppm_bin" || -z "$pdfinfo_bin" ]]; then
      print -u2 "缺少 Poppler 的 pdftoppm 或 pdfinfo。请安装 Poppler 后重试。"
      exit 127
    fi
    if [[ -z "$python_bin" ]]; then
      print -u2 "缺少 python3，无法生成 DOCX。"
      exit 127
    fi

    page_count="$("$pdfinfo_bin" "$file" 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Pages:/ {print $2; exit}')"
    if [[ -z "$page_count" ]]; then
      print -u2 "无法读取 PDF 页数：$filename"
      exit 5
    fi

    page_info="$job_dir/page-info.txt"
    if ! "$pdfinfo_bin" -f 1 -l "$page_count" "$file" >"$page_info" 2>"$job_dir/stderr.log"; then
      print -u2 "读取 PDF 页面信息失败：$filename"
      cat "$job_dir/stderr.log" >&2
      exit 5
    fi

    pages_dir="$job_dir/pages"
    mkdir -p "$pages_dir"
    if ! "$pdftoppm_bin" -png -r 144 "$file" "$pages_dir/page" >"$job_dir/stdout.log" 2>>"$job_dir/stderr.log"; then
      print -u2 "渲染 PDF 页面失败：$filename"
      cat "$job_dir/stderr.log" >&2
      exit 5
    fi

    page_images=("$pages_dir"/page-*.png(Nn))
    if (( ${#page_images[@]} == 0 )); then
      print -u2 "PDF 没有生成可用页面：$filename"
      exit 6
    fi

    if ! "$python_bin" - "$page_info" "$staged" "${page_images[@]}" <<'PY'
import re
import sys
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def read_page_sizes(info):
    sizes = [
        (float(width), float(height))
        for width, height in re.findall(
            r"^Page\s+\d+\s+size:\s+([0-9.]+)\s+x\s+([0-9.]+)\s+pts",
            info,
            flags=re.MULTILINE,
        )
    ]
    if sizes:
        return sizes
    match = re.search(
        r"^Page size:\s+([0-9.]+)\s+x\s+([0-9.]+)\s+pts",
        info,
        flags=re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("Cannot read PDF page dimensions")
    return [(float(match.group(1)), float(match.group(2)))]


def image_paragraph(index, width_pt, height_pt, page_width, page_height):
    scale = min((page_width - 12) / width_pt, (page_height - 12) / height_pt)
    width_emu = round(width_pt * scale * 12700)
    height_emu = round(height_pt * scale * 12700)
    page_break = '<w:pageBreakBefore/>' if index else ''
    rel_id = f"rId{index + 1}"
    image_name = f"page-{index + 1}.png"
    return f'''<w:p>
      <w:pPr>{page_break}<w:spacing w:before="120" w:after="0"/><w:jc w:val="center"/></w:pPr>
      <w:r><w:drawing>
        <wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0">
          <wp:extent cx="{width_emu}" cy="{height_emu}"/>
          <wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/>
          <wp:docPr id="{index + 1}" name="Page {index + 1}"/>
          <wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr>
          <a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture">
            <pic:pic>
              <pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="{index + 1}" name="{image_name}"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr>
              <pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="{rel_id}"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill>
              <pic:spPr>
                <a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="{width_emu}" cy="{height_emu}"/></a:xfrm>
                <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>
              </pic:spPr>
            </pic:pic>
          </a:graphicData></a:graphic>
        </wp:inline>
      </w:drawing></w:r>
    </w:p>'''


info_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
output_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
image_paths = [Path(value) for value in sys.argv[3:]]
sizes = read_page_sizes(info_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
if len(sizes) == 1:
    sizes *= len(image_paths)
if len(sizes) != len(image_paths):
    raise ValueError("PDF page count does not match rendered image count")

page_width, page_height = sizes[0]
paragraphs = "\n".join(
    image_paragraph(index, width, height, page_width, page_height)
    for index, (width, height) in enumerate(sizes)
)
page_width_twips = round(page_width * 20)
page_height_twips = round(page_height * 20)

document_xml = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
 xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
 xmlns:wp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing"
 xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"
 xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture">
  <w:body>
    {paragraphs}
    <w:sectPr>
      <w:pgSz w:w="{page_width_twips}" w:h="{page_height_twips}"/>
      <w:pgMar w:top="0" w:right="0" w:bottom="0" w:left="0" w:header="0" w:footer="0" w:gutter="0"/>
    </w:sectPr>
  </w:body>
</w:document>'''

relationships = "\n".join(
    f'<Relationship Id="rId{index + 1}" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image" Target="media/page-{index + 1}.png"/>'
    for index in range(len(image_paths))
)
document_rels = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  {relationships}
</Relationships>'''

content_types = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">
  <Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>
  <Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>
  <Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/>
  <Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/docProps/core.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.core-properties+xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/docProps/app.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.extended-properties+xml"/>
</Types>'''

root_rels = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/>
  <Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships/metadata/core-properties" Target="docProps/core.xml"/>
  <Relationship Id="rId3" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/extended-properties" Target="docProps/app.xml"/>
</Relationships>'''

timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
core_xml = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<cp:coreProperties xmlns:cp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties"
 xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
 xmlns:dcterms="http://purl.org/dc/terms/"
 xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <dc:title>PDF conversion</dc:title>
  <dc:creator>NotchAny</dc:creator>
  <cp:lastModifiedBy>NotchAny</cp:lastModifiedBy>
  <dcterms:created xsi:type="dcterms:W3CDTF">{timestamp}</dcterms:created>
  <dcterms:modified xsi:type="dcterms:W3CDTF">{timestamp}</dcterms:modified>
</cp:coreProperties>'''

app_xml = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Properties xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/extended-properties"
 xmlns:vt="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/docPropsVTypes">
  <Application>NotchAny</Application>
</Properties>'''

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(output_path, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    archive.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", content_types)
    archive.writestr("_rels/.rels", root_rels)
    archive.writestr("docProps/core.xml", core_xml)
    archive.writestr("docProps/app.xml", app_xml)
    archive.writestr("word/document.xml", document_xml)
    archive.writestr("word/_rels/document.xml.rels", document_rels)
    for index, image_path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
        archive.write(image_path, f"word/media/page-{index}.png")
PY
    then
      print -u2 "生成版式保真 DOCX 失败：$filename"
      exit 5
    fi
    input_note="（版式保真，页面以图片嵌入）"
  else
    if [[ -z "$soffice_bin" ]]; then
      print -u2 "缺少 soffice。请安装 LibreOffice 后重试。"
      exit 127
    fi

    conversion_input="$file"
    if [[ "$ext" == "doc" ]]; then
      if [[ -z "$python_bin" ]]; then
        print -u2 "缺少 python3，无法识别这个 .doc 是否为网页文档。"
        exit 127
      fi

      extracted_html="$job_dir/$base.html"
      "$python_bin" - "$file" "$extracted_html" <<'PY'
import base64
import sys
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
from pathlib import Path

source = Path(sys.argv[1])
target = Path(sys.argv[2])
data = source.read_bytes()
header = data[:16384].lower()
if b"mime-version:" not in header or b"content-type:" not in header or b"multipart/" not in header:
    raise SystemExit(10)

message = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parsebytes(data)
html_part = next((part for part in message.walk() if part.get_content_type() == "text/html"), None)
if html_part is None:
    print("MHTML 文档中没有找到 HTML 正文。", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(11)

payload = html_part.get_payload(decode=True) or b""
charset = html_part.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
try:
    html = payload.decode(charset)
except (LookupError, UnicodeDecodeError):
    html = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

for part in message.walk():
    if part is html_part or part.is_multipart():
        continue
    resource = part.get_payload(decode=True)
    if not resource:
        continue
    media_type = part.get_content_type() or "application/octet-stream"
    data_uri = f"data:{media_type};base64,{base64.b64encode(resource).decode('ascii')}"
    content_id = (part.get("Content-ID") or "").strip().strip("<>")
    location = (part.get("Content-Location") or "").strip()
    if content_id:
        html = html.replace(f"cid:{content_id}", data_uri)
    if location:
        html = html.replace(location, data_uri)

target.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
PY
      parse_status=$?

      if (( parse_status == 0 )); then
        conversion_input="$extracted_html"
        input_note="（已解析网页文档）"
      elif (( parse_status != 10 )); then
        print -u2 "解析网页封装失败：$filename"
        exit 8
      fi
    fi

    if ! "$soffice_bin" "-env:UserInstallation=file://$profile_dir" --headless --convert-to "$target_ext" --outdir "$job_dir" "$conversion_input" >"$job_dir/stdout.log" 2>"$job_dir/stderr.log"; then
      print -u2 "转换失败：$filename"
      cat "$job_dir/stdout.log" >&2
      cat "$job_dir/stderr.log" >&2
      exit 5
    fi
  fi

  if [[ ! -s "$staged" ]]; then
    print -u2 "转换器未生成目标文件：$filename"
    [[ -f "$job_dir/stdout.log" ]] && cat "$job_dir/stdout.log" >&2
    [[ -f "$job_dir/stderr.log" ]] && cat "$job_dir/stderr.log" >&2
    exit 6
  fi

  destination="$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR/$base.$target_ext"
  if [[ -e "$destination" ]]; then
    suffix=1
    while [[ -e "$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR/$base ($suffix).$target_ext" ]]; do
      suffix=$((suffix + 1))
    done
    destination="$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR/$base ($suffix).$target_ext"
  fi

  mv "$staged" "$destination"
  outputs+=("$destination")
  details+="$filename → ${destination:t}$input_note"$'\n'
done

if (( ${#outputs[@]} == 0 )); then
  print -u2 "没有可转换的文件。"
  exit 7
fi

details="${details%$'\n'}"
result_args=(--summary "已转换 ${#outputs[@]} 个文件" --details "$details")
for output in "${outputs[@]}"; do
  result_args+=(--output "$output")
done
notch_result "${result_args[@]}"
